name: PER_LDAP_ROLES
description: Table for storing one record for each Role Addition or Removal to be processed in OIM

columns.name: LDAP_ROLE_ID
columns.description: Mandatory Primary Key. Updatable while new key generation.

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: LDAP_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to LDAP request

columns.name: REQUEST_TYPE
columns.description: The type of request to perform: ADD, REMOVE

columns.name: REQUEST_STATUS
columns.description: The current status of this part of the request: REQUEST, IN PROGRESS, COMPLETE, REJECTED

columns.name: ROLE_GUID
columns.description: The role Guid of the role that is to be added as a member of another role (is renamed from PARENT_ROLE_GUID).

columns.name: PARENT_ROLE_GUID
columns.description: The role Guid of the role that is the parent of the role to be added.

columns.name: ROLE_NAME
columns.description: The name of the role being added

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: The description of the role being added

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ROLE_COMMON_NAME
columns.description: Role common name

columns.name: EXTERNAL_ID
columns.description: EXTERNAL_ID

columns.name: ROLE_TYPE
columns.description: ROLE_TYPE

columns.name: APPLICATION
columns.description: APPLICATION
